titleBack: In The Hands Of The Empire

flipToBack.prose: Flip if you control at least 3 Ralltiir sites each with an Imperial there, and opponent controls no Ralltiir locations.

children.req: control-with (count 3): you control 3 Ralltiir sites, each with an Imperial
control (opponent): opponent controls any Ralltiir location

flipToFront.prose: Back flips to front if opponent controls at least 2 Ralltiir locations.

children.req: control (opponent, count 2): opponent controls 2 Ralltiir locations

requirementSemantics: Flip-to-back uses CONTROL-WITH: each of the 3 Ralltiir SITES must be controlled by you AND have an Imperial there (controlsWith), not merely occupied.
Opponent negative constraint uses CONTROL of Ralltiir LOCATIONS (sites or system), count 0 on front; count 2 on back flip-back.
Site vs location asymmetry: your gate counts Ralltiir SITES; opponent constraints count Ralltiir LOCATIONS (includes the system).
Both sides carry a place-out-of-play timing trigger: TriggerConditions.isBlownAwayLastStep(Filters.and(CardSubtype.SYSTEM, Filters.title(Title.Ralltiir, true))).
typedIdentities: OccupiesWithEvaluator(self, playerId, Filters.Ralltiir_location, Filters.Imperial) (back battle-destiny bonus)
setupAndPullRoutes: Setup (required on objective deploy): deploy Ralltiir system from Reserve Deck (Filters.Ralltiir_system) (Card7_300.java:50-60).

Front once per deploy phase (GameTextActionId.RALLTIIR_OPERATIONS__DOWNLOAD_SITE_OR_NONUNIQUE_IMPERIAL_TO_RALLTIIR): deploy one site OR one non-unique Imperial from Reserve Deck to Ralltiir system (Filters.or(Filters.site, Filters.and(Filters.non_unique, Filters.Imperial)) via DeployCardToSystemFromReserveDeckEffect to Title.Ralltiir); reshuffle (Card7_300.java:63-82).
Back once per control phase (GameTextActionId.IN_THE_HANDS_OF_THE_EMPIRE__UPLOAD_CARD): use 2 Force to take ANY one card into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle (Card7_300_BACK.java:63-86).
otherObligations: Both sides: each Rebel is deploy +2 at Ralltiir locations (DeployCostToLocationModifier) (Card7_300.java:87; Card7_300_BACK.java:57).
Back: opponent's Force drains are -1 everywhere (ForceDrainModifier Filters.any) (Card7_300_BACK.java:56).
Back: add X to your total battle destiny at all locations, X = number of Ralltiir locations your Imperials occupy (OccupiesWithEvaluator) (Card7_300_BACK.java:58).
Both sides HARD LOSE: objective placed out of play if Ralltiir system is blown away (Card7_300.java:97-106; Card7_300_BACK.java:94-103).
Strategic: hold 3 Imperial-manned Ralltiir sites to flip; after flip, keep opponent below 2 controlled Ralltiir locations or it flips back.
